query: INSERT INTO central.artifact_reconciliation_claims (artifact_id, workspace_id, claim_kind, coordinator_generation, claim_token_hash, lease_expires_at, attempt_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ($1, $2, 'large', $3, $4, clock_timestamp(), 1, clock_timestamp(), clock_timestamp()) ON CONFLICT (artifact_id) DO UPDATE SET claim_kind = 'large', coordinator_generation = EXCLUDED.coordinator_generation, claim_token_hash = EXCLUDED.claim_token_hash, lease_expires_at = clock_timestamp(), updated_at = clock_timestamp()
